notes.title: Small Content Update
notes.content:
Another update has been release for Armada! Within two weeks none the less. Here are the new additions and changes to the game I have added in that time.

 - Time to kill has been lowered slightly (weapons deal more damage overall)
 - Players will now flash red when hit
 - Two maps have been added, and are chosen at random

I plan on continuing this same trend with releasing update every two to three weeks, and hope that I can slowly produce a more satisfying game for everyone.

Of course, I encourage everyone to send me feedback about the quality of the game in its current state. It's going to be buggy for most of its lifetime, and the sooner I recieve feedback, the sooner I can work on an update and get it to you all as fast as I can go.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
It's been nearly a month since the last update, and I figured I should release something to remind players that the game isn't dead, just at a slow, misreable crawl.

Updates
 - Flintlock now works properly, shooting at a more balanced rate.
 - Reduced number of public servers from three to one, to increase likelyhood of meeting other players

I'll try to work on the game more frequently, but I encourage everyone to use the community to point out bugs or glitches that may occur so that I can fix them as quickly as I can. I still have future plans for the game, I've just been slow and lazy as to getting them out to the five of you that have played the game.

notes.title: Minor Update and Additions
notes.content:
Several changes have been made to hopefully improve matchmaking and gameplay, along with a few other changes and fixes.

 - Three, randomly chosen public servers added
 - Sword model updated
 - Music readded, with option to mute in main menu
 - Server names are now displayed in the pause menu

More updates are coming soon, such as more weapons and sound effects in the near future. Later in development, I will be trying to create a roadmap of where I plan for the game to go for the later future.

- Music readded, with option to mute in main menu
- Server names are now displayed in the pause menu
